title: The Transfer Experience in Public Health
description: SPHL206 is more than just a course--it's a launchpad. Designed specifically for transfer students in the School of Public Health, this course tools, space, and support needed to successfully transition to the University of Maryland. Students will benefit from a practical yet inspiring course that blends academic planning with personal development and real-world application. Students will build a personalized graduation plan, strengthen time and stress management skills, dive into resume and cover letter writing, explore career pathways in public health and discover how to maximize your time at UMD through leadership opportunities and co-curricular involvement. Most importantly, the voice as a transfer student is centered with a focus on leadership, belonging, and holistic success.
